# bilibili-mcp

Content-intelligence bridge for Bilibili (B站), China's largest video
platform. Search, trending, video intel and transcript summarisation. No
account needed for the core tier.

## Execution

- Default: API bridge (no host app, no GUI). Talks to Bilibili public web
  APIs over HTTPS.
- Anonymous tier works out of the box. Account tier (following, favorites)
  needs a +86 login cookie (`BILIBILI_COOKIE`).

## Artifacts

- In: search keyword, Bilibili URL (BV.../av...)
- Out: video metadata + stats, transcript text, comment summaries
